# Patriot Software

> > Patriot Software provides small business accounting and payroll solutions with comprehensive educational resources on tax compliance, wage laws, and financial management.

Based in Canton, OH, Patriot Software serves small businesses with software tools and expert guidance on payroll processing, accounting fundamentals, IRS compliance, and employer obligations under federal and state labor laws including FLSA regulations.

## Key Topics

- Payroll taxes and compliance
- IRS forms and tax filing
- FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)
- S Corporation and LLC taxation
- Employee benefits and compensation
- State labor laws (California, Nevada, New Jersey, Virginia)
- Small business accounting basics
- Wage and hour requirements
- Employer compliance obligations
- Business tax structures (C Corp, S Corp, LLC)
- Pass-through taxation
- Asset valuation and accounting principles
- Multi-state payroll requirements
- Unemployment tax (FUTA/SUTA)
- Form 2553 S Corp election

## Payroll Tax and Compliance

- [Payroll Taxes for Out of State Employees: How to Handle](https://www.patriotsoftware.com/blog/payroll/state-income-taxes-state-employees): Multi-state payroll tax withholding guide for out-of-state employees
- [Who Pays Unemployment Tax: Employer and Employee Guide](https://www.patriotsoftware.com/blog/payroll/who-pays-unemployment-tax): FUTA and SUTA unemployment tax responsibilities and exemptions explained
- [Handling Outstanding Checks in Payroll | Comprehensive Guide](https://www.patriotsoftware.com/blog/payroll/handle-outstanding-paychecks): Employer responsibilities for unclaimed paychecks and escheatment rules
- [IRIS 1099: Information Returns Intake System for E-filing](https://www.patriotsoftware.com/blog/accounting/iris-information-returns-intake-system): IRS IRIS platform guide for e-filing 1099-NEC and 1099-MISC forms

## State Labor Laws and Wage Requirements

- [California On-Call Laws: Understand Ward v. Tilly's Ruling](https://www.patriotsoftware.com/blog/payroll/california-on-call-pay-laws): California on-call pay requirements following Ward v. Tilly's ruling
- [Fast Facts for Employers on the New Virginia Overtime Law](https://www.patriotsoftware.com/blog/payroll/virginia-overtime-law): Virginia Overtime Wage Act (VOWA) requirements vs FLSA compliance guide
- [8 Nevada Labor Laws to Keep in Mind as an Employer](https://www.patriotsoftware.com/blog/payroll/nevada-labor-laws): Nevada employer compliance guide covering 8 key state labor laws
- [State Disability Insurance | Overview of States with SDI Mandates](https://www.patriotsoftware.com/blog/payroll/what-is-state-disability-insurance): SDI mandates in CA, HI, NJ, NY, and RI with employer requirements

## Employee Benefits and Compensation

- [What Is Sick Pay? | Definition, Guidelines, & Advantages](https://www.patriotsoftware.com/blog/payroll/sick-pay): Sick pay definition, mandatory requirements, and employee benefit advantages
- [De Minimis Fringe Benefits | Definition, Examples, & More](https://www.patriotsoftware.com/blog/payroll/de-minimis-fringe-benefits): IRS de minimis fringe benefits tax exemptions and employer guidelines
- [What Is A Floating Holiday? | Definition, Example, Pay, & More](https://www.patriotsoftware.com/blog/payroll/what-is-a-floating-holiday): Floating holiday definition and PTO policy implementation for employers

## Business Tax Structure and IRS Forms

- [What Is IRS Form 2553? | Form to Be Taxed as an S Corp](https://www.patriotsoftware.com/blog/accounting/irs-form-2553): Guide to IRS Form 2553 for C Corps and LLCs electing S Corp tax status
- [What Is Gross Income for Business? Earnings Before Expenses](https://www.patriotsoftware.com/blog/accounting/gross-income): Business gross income definition, calculation, and usage explained

## Accounting Fundamentals and Asset Valuation

- [Historical Cost Principle | Examples and Why It Matters](https://www.patriotsoftware.com/blog/accounting/what-is-historical-cost-principle-concept): Historical cost principle for recording assets on balance sheets explained

- [Purchase Order vs. Invoice | Differences, Examples, & More](https://www.patriotsoftware.com/blog/accounting/purchase-order-vs-invoice): Purchase order vs invoice differences explained with business examples
